author: qMPX
content: Decision: routing reason DERIVED from already-emitted per-clause 'engine' field (verus/None->in-cage, nlsat->relaxable, lean-*->lemma) not a new cert field — adding a routing field would make forge golden isqrt_class.cert.json stale, violating 'goldens byte-identical'. 'engine' IS the routing telemetry; cert schema untouched => zero golden risk.
